Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: Maisha Namba (launched Nov 2023) - a Unique Personal Identifier (UPI) - integrates civil registration and national registration databases. The eCitizen Digital ID operates as a Data Exchange Layer communicating via APIs with Government Population Registries. Maisha Namba is tied to NHIF, NEMIS (schools), KRA, NSSF, death certificates, banking, SIM registration, and M-Pesa. 13+ million registered as of 2025 with 20,000-30,000 issued daily. Integration is partially operational across multiple systems though not yet fully universal.
